_meta.description: Frozen two-branch Platt calibration S -> P(aggregation error > 100 km) for live operation of the transforms. Branch 'mobile' applies when ip-api reports mobile=true; otherwise (also when the flag is not retrievable) 'default'. p = sigmoid(a + b*S).
_meta.note_mobile: In the mobile branch S is nearly uninformative (measured visibility limit of the consensus geometry); the branch mainly delivers the correct base rate. Curve there expectedly flat.
_meta.data_state: mixed probe pool probes+probes_holdout+probes_mobile_ext, n=1074, tau=100 km, as of 2026-08-18
_meta.feature: core_w_50 (= S of the transforms, r=50 km, line-weighted)
